paite: Pathian aw, Zion ah phatna in hon ngak nilouh hi, thuchiam na kiang ah tangtungsak in.
heading: David La / Phatna La Leh Kipahthu Genna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

paite: Thumna zapa aw, na kiang ah sa tengteng ahong pai ding hi.
english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

paite: Thulimlouhnate'n hon zoh chiang in, ka tatleknate uh nang na silsiang hi.
english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

paite: Mi, na tempul huangsung intual a om thei ding a na tel a, na kiang na naihsak in nuam asa hi; na inn hoihna in ka tai ding uh, na tempul siangthou hoihna in.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

paite: Pathian hon hondampa aw, diktatna mulkimhuai thilhihte in na hon dawng ding hi; nang kawlmong a mi tengteng leh tuipi tung a gamlapi a omte lametna na hi.
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

paite: Thilhihtheihna atai a kigak a, nangmah hatna a mualte hihkippa na hi hi.
english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

paite: Tuipi thawm ging, akihot gingte leh michih chiak vengvung hihdaipa na hi.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

paite: Kawlmong tawp a omte'n leng na theihsaknate alau ua; zingsang leh nitak paikhiaknate nuam in na kikousak hi.
english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

paite: Lei na veh a, tui in na khai a, nakpi petmah in na hihhoih hi; Pathian luitui in adim a, lei huchibang a na bawl nung in amaute a ding in buh na bawlsak hi.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

paite: Leilehte tui tampi in na vak a; asaichian na khengsak hi; vuahtui in na nemsak a, athilpoute na vualzawl zel hi.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

paite: Na hoihna in kum na khusak a; na paina lampite'n kiningchinna aluanglet hi.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

paite: Gamdai a gantatna munte ah aluanglet a, mual neute leng nopna toh akigaksuak uhi.
english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

paite: Gantatna munte ganhon in aluahsuak a; phaizangte leng buh in akhuh suak hi; nuam in akikou ua, la asa uhi.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
